cohort: 46 pregnant patients with FMF who attended the perinatology clinic of Dr Zekai Tahir Burak Research and Training Hospital between January 2008 and December 2012
finding: FMF leads to higher rates of PROM, recurrent miscarriage, and preterm deliveries, while colchicine treatment is safe during pregnancy and may decrease miscarriage rate.
mod_finding: The study found that women with Familial Mediterranean fever had higher rates of cesarean delivery compared to those without the condition.
